items.title: Basic word order: subject + time + place + verb + object
items.rule: Statements are Subject + Verb + Object (我们学中文). Words that say when, where, how or with whom go BEFORE the verb: Subject + (Time) + (在/从 + Place) + Verb + (Object) — 他十点睡觉, 哥哥在北京学中文. A time word normally follows the subject, or opens the sentence when the time is stressed. Adverbs (不, 也, 都) and modal verbs also stand before the verb; with a modal the order is Subject + Time + Modal + 在/从-phrase + Verb. One everyday exception: with 住 'to live, to stay' the 在-phrase normally follows the verb (你住在哪儿？ 你住在什么地方？), and verbs of putting or sending do the same (放在桌子上, 送到车站; see grammar.ba). Questions keep statement order (see grammar.question-words).
items.details: Official grammar syllabus (GF 0025-2021, level 1): 动词谓语句 [一25] and 'adverbs, adjectives, time and place words as adverbials' [一28] — 他十点睡觉。我们下午去吧。她在网上买了两本书。哥哥从北京回来了。; 跟/和 + person before the verb [一17] — 他跟老师请假了。我没和姐姐一起去中国。; manner before the main verb [三56] — 我明天坐飞机去北京。 发展汉语 (初级上 第5课) gives the order 主语—动词—宾语 and says adverbials normally go before the verb; 第16课: 在 + place goes before the verb, '一般情况下，介词结构不能放在动词后边'. 成功之路 (起步篇1 第6课): time words go before the verb, or at the start of the sentence when the time is emphasised. 发展汉语 (初级上 第17课): time adverbials go before a modal verb, place and prepositional phrases after the modal and before the main verb. To learn later: verbs of placing put 在/到 + place AFTER the verb to say where something ends up (老师把书放在桌子上了, 我把朋友送到车站了; see grammar.ba). Level: 2025 HSK syllabus, HSK 1 (状语: 表示时间、处所的词语作状语).

Added one sentence to the rule. Old rule ended: '…with a modal the order is Subject + Time + Modal + 在/从-phrase + Verb. Questions keep statement order (see grammar.question-words).'

items.title: 是 links two nouns: A 是 B
items.rule: Noun/Pronoun A + 是 + Noun B = 'A is B' (identity, category, job, nationality): 他是我的老师, 这是他的书. 是 has the same form for every person and tense. Negative: 不是 (not 没是). Question: …是…吗？ or 是不是. 是 is not used to link a subject with an adjective (see grammar.hen-adjective).
items.details: Official syllabus [一36] '是'字句 (1) 表示等同或类属: 他是我的老师。这是他的书。; (3) 表示存在: 车站东边是一个学校。教学楼西边不是图书馆。 发展汉语 (初级上 第1课): the 是-sentence does not change for person or number (他是老师); negative 马克不是老师。 成功之路 (起步篇1 第1课): 是 states a judgement — what something equals or belongs to; the negative uses 不. Dates, ages and prices are often said without 是 (名词谓语句: 明天星期五, 这本中文书二十五块; see grammar.time). Level: 2025 HSK syllabus, HSK 1 ('是'字句1).

items.title: Adjective predicates: subject + 很 + adjective (no 是)
items.rule: Subject + 很 / 非常 / 真 / 最 (or 太…了) + Adjective. The adjective is itself the predicate, so 是 is NOT used (*我是很好). In a plain positive statement a degree word, usually 很, is added; this 很 is unstressed and does not really mean 'very' — a bare adjective implies a contrast (这个苹果大，那个苹果小). Negative: 不 + Adjective (今天不冷). Questions: Adjective + 吗 (你忙吗？) or Adj.-不-Adj. (你忙不忙？).
items.details: Official syllabus [一30] 主谓句2：形容词谓语句 (房间很干净。这个学生最认真。), [一25] (今天不冷。这个菜很好吃。), [一09] 程度副词 非常、很、太、真、最. 1996 grammar syllabus (甲级, quoted in the reference CSV): '形容词谓语句，谓语中不用“是”：今天很热。' 成功之路 (起步篇1 第5课): no 是 before an adjective predicate; 很 is commonly added in the positive, is read lightly and does not express a marked degree; without 很 the sentence implies a comparison; the negative puts 不 before the adjective. 发展汉语 (初级上 第10课): S + Adj. with no 是 — '不能说“我是很好”'; in a contrast (这个苹果大，那个苹果小) no degree adverb is needed. Different pattern: 是…的 describing a characteristic (花是白的。衣服是干净的。 [一36]). Level: 2025 HSK syllabus, HSK 1 (主谓句2：形容词谓语句).

items.title: 有 / 没有 (to have, there is) and 在 (to be located)
items.rule: Possession: Subject + 有 + Object ('have'): 我有一个弟弟. Existence: Place + 有 + (number + measure word) + Noun ('there is / there are'): 房间里有两张桌子. The negative of 有 is always 没有 (or 没), never *不有, and after 没有 the object normally has no number: 房间里没有桌子. Location of a particular person or thing: Person/Thing + 在 + Place ('is at / in'): 书在桌子上; negative 不在: 爸爸跟妈妈都不在家. An ordinary noun becomes a place with a position word: 桌子上, 书包里, 房间里.
items.details: Official syllabus [一37] '有'字句1: (1) 表示领有 我有很多书。他没有哥哥。一个星期有七天。 (2) 表示存在 房间里有两张桌子。房间里没有桌子。; [一01] 方位名词 (桌子上 书包里边 …; 书在桌子上。手机在书包里。房间里没有人。); [一19] 爸爸跟妈妈都不在家。 成功之路 (起步篇1 第2课): 有 means possession; the negative uses 没, not 不, and the negated object takes no number. 国际汉语教学通用课程大纲 (quoted in the reference CSV): 主语+有/没有+宾语 (我有一个弟弟) and 方位短语+有+名词 (桌子上有两本书). Level: 2025 HSK syllabus, HSK 1 ('有'字句1 表示领有; 存现句1 处所+有+数量短语+名词; 介词 在).

items.title: Negation: 不 vs 没(有), and 别
items.rule: 不 + Verb/Adjective = 'not / don't / won't': for adjectives (今天不热), habits and likes (我不喜欢看电视), what someone does not do or will not do (他不去医院), and before 是, 在 and modal verbs (不是, 不在, 不会). 没(有) + Verb = 'didn't / haven't': the action did not take place (他昨天没上课, 我今天没有吃早饭); in this negative the completion 了 is dropped (他买了两个面包 → 他没买面包). 有 is negated only with 没: 没有. Experience keeps 过: 没去过. 别 + Verb = 'don't!' (你别进来).
items.details: Official syllabus [一14] 否定副词 别、不、没、没有 (你别进来。今天不热。他昨天没上课。我今天没有吃早饭。), [一29] (他不去医院。), [一32] (我不喜欢看电视。), [一02] (我不会说中文。), [一41] (他买了两个面包。／他没买面包。), [二32] (我去过一次中国。／我没去过中国。). 1996 grammar syllabus 甲116 (via the reference CSV): the negative of a completed action is 没(有) before the verb, normally without 了. 成功之路 (起步篇1 第2课): 有 takes 没, not 不. CC-CEDICT: 没 '(negative prefix for verbs) have not; not'; 不 'no; not so; not'. Tone: 不 is pronounced bú before a fourth tone (不去 bú qù, 不热 bú rè) — see 'spoken'. Level: 2025 HSK syllabus, HSK 1 (否定副词 不、没（有）、不要); 别 HSK 2.

items.title: Yes/no questions: 吗 and the affirmative-negative (A-not-A) form
items.rule: (1) Statement + 吗？ makes a yes/no question without changing the word order: 他是老师吗？ 那儿现在热吗？ (2) A-not-A: say the verb or adjective, then 不 + the same word: 你喝不喝牛奶？ 今天冷不冷？; a two-syllable word can be repeated whole (干净不干净？), but in everyday speech usually only its first syllable is repeated: 喜不喜欢？ 高不高兴？ For completed actions: …了没有？ (你吃早饭了没有？) or Verb + 没 + Verb (你吃没吃早饭？). The middle 不 is read lightly. Answer by repeating the verb or adjective, positive or negative (我买书 / 我不买). An A-not-A question does not take 吗.
items.details: Official syllabus [一45] 用'吗'提问 (他是老师吗？这包子好吃吗？), [一33] 疑问句: 是非问句 (他是老师吗？那儿现在热吗？) and 正反问句 (你喝不喝牛奶？你吃没吃早饭？你吃早饭了没有？今天冷不冷？这个房间干净不干净？), [一48] (这本书贵不贵？电影好看不好看？他回家了没有？). 发展汉语 (初级上 第10课): Adj.+吗 / Adj.+不+Adj., '其中“不”要轻读'; 第11课: S+V+不+V+(O)? is answered 我买书 / 我不买（书）; 第17课: with a modal verb the A-not-A form is modal + 不 + modal + verb. Level: 2025 HSK syllabus, HSK 1 (是非问句, 正反问句).

items.common_mistake: Answering every question with 是 / 不是. Reply with the question's own verb or adjective: 你喝不喝牛奶？ — 喝。/ 不喝。 Also, don't add 吗 to an A-not-A question: *这是不是书吗？ → 这是不是书？ or 这是书吗？

items.title: Question words: 什么, 谁, 哪儿/哪里, 哪, 几, 多少, 怎么, 为什么, 什么时候, 怎么样
items.rule: Put the question word where the answer will stand; the rest keeps statement order, and the question word itself makes the sentence a question (the syllabus examples have no 吗). 什么 what (你买什么？); 谁 who (谁是老师？); 哪儿 / 哪里 where — same meaning; 哪儿 is the northern, colloquial form and 哪里 the usual one in the south and in writing (你们去哪儿？ 车站在哪里？); 哪 + measure word which (你喜欢哪个电影？ 她是哪国人？); 几 + measure word how many — for small numbers (about 1–10), measure word required (现在几点？ 你家有几口人？); 多少 how many / how much — any number, measure word optional (你的电话号码是多少？ 多少钱？); 怎么 + verb how (你怎么去医院？); 为什么 why (你为什么不去上课？); 什么时候 when (你们什么时候见面？); 怎么样 how is…? / how about…? (明天天气怎么样？).
items.details: Official syllabus [一04] 疑问代词 多、多少、几、哪、哪儿、哪里、哪些、什么、谁、怎么 and [一46] (你家有几口人？她是哪国人？我们在哪儿见面？这个字怎么读？), [二05] 多久、为什么、怎么样、怎样, [二76] 什么时候、什么样、为什么、怎么样、怎样. 发展汉语 (初级上 第2课): in 你是哪国人？ / 你叫什么名字？ the question word keeps the word order of the statement. 成功之路 (起步篇1 第4课): 几 asks about numbers from 1 to 10 and normally needs a measure word; 多少 asks about any number and the measure word is optional (你们班有多少学生？). 发展汉语 (初级上 第8课): 几 cannot go straight before a noun (你家有几口人？); 第12课: phone numbers are read digit by digit and 1 is usually read yāo. HSK考试大纲 一级 (via CSV): 你这几本书多少钱？ 1996 grammar syllabus 甲103 (via CSV): 请问，去车站怎么走？ 'Excuse me, how do I get to the station?'. 多少 here is duōshao (CC-CEDICT and HSK: 'how much? how many?'). Level: 2025 HSK syllabus — 多、多少、几、哪、哪儿、哪里、哪些、什么、谁、怎么、怎么样 HSK 1; 为什么 HSK 2. Regional note: 哪儿 / 这儿 / 那儿 are erhua forms, marked 〈口〉 (colloquial) in 现代汉语词典 and typical of northern speech; southern Mandarin generally has no erhua, so in south/central China, and in writing, expect 哪里 / 这里 / 那里. Both sets are standard and understood everywhere.

items.common_mistake: Moving the question word to the front as in English (*什么你买？ → 你买什么？) and putting 几 straight before a noun or using it for large numbers (*几学生 → 几个学生, or 多少学生); and adding 吗 to a question-word question (*你是谁吗？ → 你是谁？). 吗 goes with a question word only inside a 'do you know…?' question: 你知道这是什么吗？

items.title: 呢: 'And you?', 'Where is…?' and follow-up questions
items.rule: (1) After a statement, Noun/Pronoun + 呢？ asks the same thing about someone or something else: 我去医院，你呢？ ('…and you?'). (2) Noun + 呢？ also asks where something is: 书在桌子上，笔呢？ ('…and where's the pen?'), 你的词典呢？ (3) 呢 can end a question that already contains a question word (他是哪国人呢？). (4) At the end of a statement 呢 marks an action in progress (我在看书呢) — see grammar.zai-progressive. A plain yes/no question uses 吗 (grammar.ma-questions).
items.details: Official syllabus [二77] 用'呢'构成的省略式疑问句'代词/名词+呢？' (我去医院，你呢？书在桌子上，笔呢？), [一22] 语气助词 呢 (他是哪国人呢？我在看书呢。), [二50] dialogue 甲：你的词典呢？乙：不好意思，我没拿来。, [二26] (她后天过生日，我们给她送什么礼物呢？). 1996 grammar syllabus 甲108 (via CSV): 我们下星期去旅行，你呢？/阿里，你的车票呢？/要是他不同意呢？ CC-CEDICT 呢: '(sentence-final particle) used in questions to link back to prior discourse or context ("what about...?", "and...?"); …indicating that a state or situation still holds'. Level: 2025 HSK syllabus — 呢1–呢3 HSK 1, 呢4 HSK 2.

examples.english: I'm going to the hospital — and you?

items.title: Measure words: number / 这 / 那 / 哪 / 几 + measure word + noun
items.rule: A number or 几 must have a measure word (classifier) before the noun: Number + MW + Noun (两个人, 三本书, 两杯牛奶). 这/那/哪 normally take one too: 这/那/哪 + (number +) MW + Noun (那个书包, 这本书, 哪个电影), although 这/那 directly before a noun also occurs in speech (the syllabus has 这包子好吃吗？). 'Two' on its own before a measure word is 两, not 二 (两个, 两本); inside a bigger number the tens and units digits stay 二 (十二个, 二十二个). Common ones: 个 (people and nouns with no special MW), 本 (books), 杯 (a cup/glass of), 口 (people in a family), 家 (shops, firms), 件 (clothes, matters), 张 (flat things: tables, tickets, sheets), 位 (people, polite), 块 (pieces; in speech also yuan: 二十五块). 这个 / 那个 / 哪个 can stand alone: 'this one, that one, which one'.
items.details: Official syllabus [一08] 名量词 杯、本、个、家、间、口、块、页 (两杯牛奶 三本书 四个学生 五家商店 六间房子 三口人 七块面包), [一07] (两个人 两本书), [一23] 数量短语 (一个 两杯 三本 四包 五块), [二10] 层、封、件、条、位 (一件衣服 一位老师), [三09] 把、张、双… (一张桌子), [一43] 钱数表示法 (九块三（毛）; 一百五十（块）). 发展汉语 (初级上 第9课, via CSV): 两 can go before every measure word (两个、两本、两张), 二 only before a few weight/length units (二斤); in speech the currency units 元、角、分 are called 块、毛、分; 第8课: 几 cannot go straight before a noun. CC-CEDICT: 个 'classifier used before a noun that has no specific classifier'; 本 'classifier for books, periodicals, files etc'; 张 'classifier for flat objects, sheet'; 位 'classifier for people (honorific)'; 件 'classifier for events, things, clothes etc'; 口 'classifier for things with mouths (people, …)'; 家 'classifier for families or businesses'; 块 '(coll.) classifier for money and currency units'. In speech 个 is often unstressed; the citation tone is gè. Level: 2025 HSK syllabus — HSK 1: 本、个、家、口、块、件、只、元, 杯; HSK 2: 条、位、间、名, 包; HSK 3: 把、双、张、种…

items.title: 的, 得, 地: the three 'de' particles
items.rule: All three are pronounced de (neutral tone) but do different jobs. 的: Modifier + 的 + Noun — possession or description before a noun (你的衣服, 干净的房间); a 的-phrase can also stand for the noun (我的, 新的, 他买的). 地: Adverbial + 地 + Verb — how an action is done (他高兴地说). 得: Verb + 得 + (很) + Adjective — how well / in what way something is done (她跑得很快, 说得很好). If the verb has an object, repeat the verb (他打篮球打得很好) or put the object first (她篮球打得很不错). With family, close friends and your own home or workplace, 的 is usually left out after a pronoun: 我妈妈, 我爸爸, 我家, 我朋友.
items.details: Official syllabus [一20] 结构助词 的、地 (你的衣服很好看。他高兴地说：'我明天回家。'), [一27] (我喜欢干净的房间。), [二38] '的'字短语 (我的 黑色的 新的 吃的 他买的), [二31] 结构助词 得 (他走得有点儿快。她篮球打得很不错。), [二51] 状态补语1：动词+得+形容词性词语 (她跑得很快。我们玩儿得很高兴。), [二63] (她不但会说中文，而且说得很好。), [三59] 重动句：主语+动词+宾语+动词+补语 (他打篮球打得很好。她游泳游得很快。). 发展汉语 (初级下 第17课, via CSV): 的 links an attributive to its noun and forms 的-phrases that work like nouns; 地 marks the adverbial before a verb/adjective (他慢慢地走着); 得 follows the verb/adjective and introduces a complement of degree or possibility (衣服洗得真干净). CC-CEDICT gives de (neutral) for the particle readings of 地 and 得. Level: 2025 HSK syllabus — 的 HSK 1; 得、地 HSK 2.

items.common_mistake: Mixing up 的/得/地 in writing (they sound the same), and putting the object between the verb and 得 (*他打篮球得很好): the syllabus pattern repeats the verb (他打篮球打得很好) or fronts the object (她篮球打得很不错). Learner essays show the 的/得 and 的/地 mix-ups: *时间过的很愉快 → 过得很愉快; *快乐的写日记 → 快乐地写日记.

items.title: 了: completed action (verb + 了) and change of situation (sentence + 了)
items.rule: (1) Verb + 了 (了1) marks an action as completed: Subject + Verb + 了 + (number + MW +) Object — 他买了两个面包, 我喝了很多水. If the object is a bare noun, a sentence-final 了 is usually added (他吃早饭了). (2) Sentence + 了 (了2) signals a change or new situation: 我累了 ('I'm tired now'), 她病了, 十一点了，该睡觉了; 要 / 快要 / 就要 + Verb + 了 = 'about to': 要下雨了. (3) Negative: 没(有) + Verb, without 了: 他没买面包. (4) 了 is not a past tense: it marks completion whatever the time (明天吃了早饭我们一起去公园), and repeated/habitual actions do not take sentence-final 了.
items.details: Official syllabus [一21] 动态助词 了1 (他买了一本书。／他没买书。), [一41] 完成态 (他买了两个面包。／他没买面包。我喝了很多水。／我没喝水。), [一40] 变化态 了2 (她病了。／她没病。雨小了。他吃早饭了。／他没吃早饭。), [一22] (我累了。), [二80] 该……了 (十一点了，该睡觉了。), [二81] 要／快要／就要……了 (要下雨了。我们快要放假了。). 1996 grammar syllabus 甲116 (via CSV): 了 relates only to completion, not to when the action happens — it is used for past, future and habitual actions (明天吃了早饭我们一起去公园。每天我下了课就回宿舍。); negative 没(有) + verb, normally without 了. 甲117: sentence-final 了 for a change that has happened (天冷了…/她的病好了) or is about to happen (要下雨了。快要考试了…). 尔雅中文 (初级上 第8课, via CSV): with 了1 the object normally carries a quantity; if not, add sentence-final 了; 第6课: no sentence-final 了 for habitual actions, and none in the negative. 发展汉语 (初级上 第28课): 我买了三本书 differs from 我买三本书了; answers 没有 / 还没有呢; questions …了没有？ / V没V. Level: 2025 HSK syllabus, HSK 1 (了1 完成态, 了2 变化态).

items.title: 过: past experience ('have done / have ever done')
items.rule: Subject + Verb + 过 (+ Object) = has done something (at least once) — an experience: 我去过中国, 我吃过饺子. Negative: 没(有) + Verb + 过 — keep 过 (我没去过中国). Questions: …过…吗？ / …过…没有？ / Verb 没 Verb 过 (你去没去过长城？). The number of times goes after 过: 我去过一次中国 / 我来过中国一次. Contrast: 他去过上海 (he has been there; he is not there now) vs 他去了上海 (he went; he is there now).
items.details: Official syllabus [二32] 动态助词 过 (我去过一次中国。／我没去过中国。他学过一点儿中文。／他没学过中文。), [二71] 经历态 (他学过中文。／他没学过中文。我吃过饺子。／我没吃过饺子。), [三50] (我来过中国一次。我去过两次上海。), [二79] (你以前学过中文吧？), [三14] (我曾经学过一年中文。). 1996 grammar syllabus 甲120 (via CSV): 过 says that something happened in the past; negative 没有……过 (我学过英语，没学过法语。/我没有去过西安。). 发展汉语 (初级上 第35课, via CSV): V+过 stresses an experience that no longer continues (我去过日本 — not in Japan now); the object follows 过; questions 你去过长城没有？/你去没去过长城？; negative 没(有)+V+过; unlike 了, 过 stays in the negative; 他去过上海 (no longer there) vs 他去了上海 (there now). CC-CEDICT: 过 guo (neutral) '(experienced action marker)'. Level: 2025 HSK syllabus, HSK 2 (动态助词 过; 经历态).

items.title: 在 / 正在 + verb (… 呢): actions in progress
items.rule: Subject + 在 / 正在 + Verb (+ Object) (+ 呢) = is (was) doing something at that moment: 他们正在唱歌, 外边正在下雨, 他在打电话呢. Sentence-final 呢 alone can also mark it (我洗衣服呢). 正 is used in the frame 正 + Verb … 呢 (他正吃饭呢). To say someone is not doing something, use 没 + Verb: 我没看电视，看书呢.
items.details: Official syllabus [一42] 进行态: (1) ……在／正在＋动词 (孩子在睡觉，你别说话。外边正在下雨。) (2) ……在／正／正在＋动词……＋呢 (你等一下儿，他在打电话呢。老师进来的时候，我正听歌呢。同学们正在考试呢。) (3) ……呢 (我没看电视，看书呢。甲：你在做什么？乙：我洗衣服呢。); [一11] 时间副词 在、正、正在 (我在看电视呢。你等一下儿，他正吃饭呢。他们正在唱歌。). 1996 grammar syllabus 甲119 (via CSV): 进行态 with 正、正在、在、呢、正(在)……呢、在……呢 (孩子们在睡觉，你小声点儿！请您等一会儿，他们在开会。). The progressive 在 (before a verb: 他在打电话) is listed separately from the location preposition 在 (before a place: 哥哥在北京学中文, [一16]). Level: 2025 HSK syllabus, HSK 1 (时间副词 在、正在; 进行态 all three patterns). Regional note: 一下儿 in 你等一下儿 is the northern erhua form; in south/central China and in writing people say 你等一下 (same meaning).

items.common_mistake: Confusing the two uses of 在: 在 + Verb = in progress (他在打电话); 在 + Place = location (哥哥在北京学中文). To deny an ongoing action the syllabus example uses 没, not 不 (我没看电视，看书呢).

items.title: Modal verbs: 想, 要, 会, 能, 可以
items.rule: Subject + (time) + Modal + Verb (+ Object); negate with 不 before the modal; A-not-A doubles the modal (能不能…, 会不会…). 想 + V = would like to / plan to (我想学中文); negative 不想. 要 + V = want to, be going to (他要去书店), also 'need to / should' (你生病了，要多喝水); 要 + noun = want, would like to have (我要两个本子). The negative of 'want to' is 不想 — 不要 + verb means 'don't!'. To offer something, ask 要不要 + noun? (你们要不要米饭？ 'Do you want rice?'). 'Don't need to' is 不用 (不用介绍了 'no need for introductions'), not 不要. 会 + V = can, having learned how (我不会说中文); also 'will (probably)' (今天可能会下雨). 能 + V = can, be able / circumstances allow (明天你能来吗？); 不能 also 'must not' (这里不能打电话). 可以 + V = may, be allowed (老师，我可以进来吗？ 这儿不可以停车).
items.details: Official syllabus [一02] 会、能 (我不会说中文。明天你能来吗？), [一03] 想、要 (我想学中文。他要去书店。), [二01] 可以 (老师，我可以进来吗？这儿不可以停车。), [二52] (我能用用你的手机吗？), [二75] (你明天早点儿来，可以吗？). Notes quoted in the reference CSV: 发展汉语 (初级上 第17课) — modal verbs stand before the verb and express ability, wish, need, possibility, permission; the negative puts 不 before the modal; A-not-A = modal + 不 + modal + verb; 想 = hope/plan, negative 不想; 要 = wish to do something, '其否定形式是“不想”不能说“不要”' (我不想打球); 会 = a skill acquired through study (他会说汉语); 能 and 可以 = having the ability or the conditions; time words go before the modal, place phrases after it. 成功之路 (起步篇2 第14/17/19课): 会 = a learned skill, '不表示条件'; 能 = ability or conditions; 可以 = permission (房间里可以上网). HSK考试大纲 examples (via CSV): 我会做饭。今天可能会下雨。我在饭店，你几点能来？先生，这里不能打电话。你生病了，要多喝水，多休息。 CC-CEDICT: 会 'can; to have the skill; to know how to; to be likely to'; 能 'can; to be able to'; 可以 'can; may'; 要 'to want; to need; will; shall; about to; need to; should'; 不要 'don't!; must not'. Level: 2025 HSK syllabus, HSK 1 (会、能、想、要、可以).

source.evidence: CSV row 2 (一级 能愿动词) quotes 发展汉语 初级上 第17课: '（2）要。“要”可以用作一般动词，也可以用作能愿动词，表示做某事的愿望。如：我要跟你一起走。其否定形式是“不想”不能说“不要”。如：我不想打球。'.

items.common_mistake: Saying 不要 for 'don't want to' (use 不想: 我不想打球; 不要 = 'don't!'). For a skill learned by study, 会 is the usual verb (我不会说中文); 能 is about ability or circumstances (明天你能来吗？). Time words go before the modal (明天你能来吗？).

sources.publisher: 中国社会科学院语言研究所词典编辑室, 商务印书馆 (7th ed.); community transcription CNMan/XDHYCD7th
sources.evidence: 【会】²❸助动词。表示懂得怎样做或有能力做（多半指需要学习的事情）：我不会滑冰 ❺表示有可能实现. 【能】❹助动词…注意a）'能'表示具备某种能力或达到某种效率，'会'表示学得某种本领. 【可以】¹❷表示许可：你可以走了. 【想】❸希望；打算. 【要】²❶希望得到：他要一台电脑 ❹表示做某件事的意志 ❺须要；应该 ❼将要：要下雨了. 【不要】〈副〉表示禁止和劝阻. 【不用】〈副〉表示事实上没有必要：不用介绍了，我们认识.

items.title: Comparisons: A 比 B + adjective; A 没有 B (那么) + adjective
items.rule: A + 比 + B + Adjective = 'A is more … than B': 我朋友比我高. No 很 / 非常 / 真 before the adjective (*比我很高); for 'even more' use 更 or 还 (今天比昨天还凉快); to say by how much, put the amount AFTER the adjective (姐姐比我大两岁; …凉快一些; 冷多了). Negative: A + 没有 + B + (这么/那么) + Adjective = 'A is not as … as B' (昨天没有今天热; 我们国家的菜没有四川菜那么辣). A 不比 B + Adjective means 'A is no more … than B' (about the same), not the plain negative.
items.details: Official syllabus [一38] 比较句1: (1) A比B+形容词 (我朋友比我高。这个手机比那个贵。) (2) A没有B+形容词 (昨天没有今天热。这个书包没有那个好看。); [二58] 比较句2: A比B+形容词+数量补语 (姐姐比我大两岁。房间外边比里边凉快一些。), A比B+更/还+形容词 (他的手机比我的更贵。今天比昨天还凉快。), A不如B, A有B(+这么/那么)+形容词 (你哥哥有你高吗？); [三58] A不比B+形容词 (我姐姐不比我高。). 成功之路 (起步篇2 第25课, via CSV): in 比-sentences no '很''非常''十分' and no 不 before the predicate; 第26课: A没有B+(这么/那么)+Adj (我们国家的菜没有四川菜那么辣); 进步篇3 第26课: the negative of 比 is 'A没有B…', while 'A不比B…' basically means A and B are about the same. 发展汉语 (初级下 第9/10课): 他不比小王高 (about the same height) vs 他没有小王高 (shorter); '数量词一定要在形容词后' (姐姐比我大三岁); 还/更 when B already has the quality. 国际汉语教学通用课程大纲 (via CSV): A+比+B+形容词+一点儿/得多/多了/数量短语 (今天比昨天冷多了). Level: 2025 HSK syllabus, HSK 2 (比较句1: A比B+形容词; …+数量补语/程度补语; A有/没有B(+这么/那么)+形容词).

items.title: 太…了 ('too' / 'so…!') and 有点儿 ('a bit', usually unwelcome)
items.rule: 太 + Adjective + 了 = 'too …' or, as an exclamation, 'so …!' — it can praise or complain: 这里太冷了, 今天的电影太好看了, 打车太贵了. 有(一)点儿 + Adjective = 'a bit, slightly', mostly about something unwelcome: 有点儿贵, 有点儿远. Don't confuse it with Adjective + 一点儿 ('a bit more …'), used when comparing or asking for a change: 今天凉快一点儿 ('a bit cooler than yesterday'), 快(一)点儿走！
items.details: Official syllabus [一09] 程度副词 太 (这里太冷了。), [一12] (今天的电影太好看了，我们明天再去看吧。), [一35] 感叹句 (今天太热了！), [二45] (打车太贵了，你还是坐地铁吧。), [二13] 有(一)点儿 (今天天气有(一)点儿热。), [二27] (这儿离车站有点儿远。), [二65] (这件衣服样子不错，有点儿贵。), [二53] 形容词+数量补语 (昨天很热，今天凉快一点儿。). 发展汉语 (初级上 第12课, via CSV): '太+形容词+了' is an exclamation that can express praise, liking or dissatisfaction (太好了). 发展汉语 (初级上 第22课): 有点儿+Adj. = small amount/low degree, 'mostly for things one is not happy about or does not want' (这本书有点儿贵); V+一点儿(+N) = a small amount (喝一点儿吧！我要喝一点儿水。); Adj.+一点儿 is used when comparing (快(一)点儿走！). 成功之路 (起步篇2 第23课): 有点儿 + Adj. = a low degree, '多用于不如意的事情'. HSK考试大纲 (via CSV): 今天太冷了，我不想去。我这两天有点儿忙。 Level: 2025 HSK syllabus, HSK 1 (程度副词 非常、很、太、真、有（一）点儿). Regional note: 有点儿 / 一点儿 are the erhua (northern) forms that textbooks and HSK papers print; in south/central China and in writing 有点 / 一点 are the usual forms, with the same meaning.

items.common_mistake: Using 有点儿 for a compliment — it mostly signals something unwelcome, so for praise use 很 / 真 / 太…了 (太好看了！); and mixing up the positions: 有点儿 goes before the adjective (有点儿贵), 一点儿 after it or after a verb (凉快一点儿, 喝一点儿).

items.title: Time words, dates and clock times (年 月 日/号, 星期, 点 分 半 刻 差)
items.rule: Dates run from large to small: year 年 + month 月 + day 日/号 (+ weekday): 2020年12月25日, 七月十号. In everyday speech the day is 号; in writing it is 日. Years are read digit by digit: 2020年 = èr líng èr líng nián. Weekdays: 星期 + 一…六; Sunday is 星期日 or 星期天. Clock time: number + 点 (o'clock) + number + 分 (minutes): 两点 (2:00, with 两), 两点二十五(分), 三点零五(分) (零 before single-digit minutes); 半 = half past (五点半); 一刻 = quarter past, 三刻 = quarter to the next hour (两点一刻 = 2:15, 两点三刻 = 2:45); 差 + minutes + hour = 'to' (差两分八点 = 7:58; also 八点差两分). Time expressions go before the verb, larger unit first (我们明天八点出发). A date, day or clock time can be the predicate without 是 (明天星期五, 现在八点二十分); 是 is also fine (现在是十点十分).
items.details: Official syllabus [一44] 时间表示法: (1) 年、月、日、星期 (2020年12月25日; 七月十号; 星期一 … 星期六 星期日／星期天) (2) 钟点 (两点 2:00; 两点二十五(分) 2:25; 三点零五(分) 3:05; 五点半 5:30; 差两分八点 7:58); [二54] 名词谓语句 (现在八点二十分。), [二48] (明天星期五。), [二75] (我们明天八点出发，好吗？), [三74] 八点左右 'around 8'. 1996 grammar syllabus 甲110–111 (via CSV): 两点(钟) 2:00; 两点(过/零)五分 2:05; 两点十五(分)(两点一刻) 2:15; 两点半 2:30; 两点四十五(分)(两点三刻/差一刻三点) 2:45; 两点五十八分(差两分三点) 2:58. The year example is written here with Chinese numerals (二〇二〇年), as it is read digit by digit (èr líng èr líng). Level: 2025 HSK syllabus — 年、月、日、星期 and 钟点 HSK 1 (时量词 日、号、岁、点、分、年、天); 刻 is an HSK 3 measure word. Everyday alternatives: many people just read the digits (十一点十五, 十点零七 — 分 is often dropped), and 十五分 / 四十五分 can replace 一刻 / 三刻. Weekdays are also said 周一…周日 (very common in writing and on schedules; 周末 'weekend') and, colloquially, 礼拜一…礼拜天 (现代汉语词典 marks 礼拜 〈口〉; teaching blogs say it is heard more in the south). Learn 星期 first.

sources.title: How to Say the Days of the Week in Chinese
sources.publisher: The Chairman's Bao
sources.evidence: Search result: 星期 + number is the standard form ('more common in northern China'); 礼拜 is the older form, 'more common in southern China'; 周 is very common in writing. verification.notes: Checker: 9/9 OK (spoken wú diǎn bàn, liáng diǎn yí kè correct). GF examples re-found (PDF pp. 28, 34, 35, 39); CSV row 44 (1996 syllabus 甲110–111, 两点一刻) re-found. Independent: Chinese Grammar Wiki 'Structure of dates' and 'Structure of times'; 现代汉语词典 号¹ ❾b ('五月一号'), 刻 ❸ ('下午五点一刻开车'), 周¹ ❻, 礼拜 〈口〉; HSK papers: the listening scripts use 号 ('我买的机票是八月七号的' H20902 听力 29) while reading texts use 日 ('今天是7月12日' H20901 阅读 48); '现在差一刻十点' (H31003 听力), '现在差十分十二点' (2009 HSK 3 sample 听力 23), '现在十一点十五了' (H31001 阅读 56), '十点零七' (H20901 阅读 49), '现在是十点十分' (H10901 听力 7), '今天星期四' (H10901 听力 17). CORRECTED (usage): resolved the researcher's open questions and added to the rule: 号 spoken vs 日 written, years read digit by digit, optional 是, and the alternative order 八点差两分; added to details: digit reading (十一点十五), 十五分 for 一刻, and the weekday alternatives 周一 and colloquial 礼拜一 (the 'more common in the south' claim for 礼拜 rests only on a blog and a forum post, so it is worded as hearsay). The examples are unchanged; 二〇二〇年十二月二十五日 with 日 is the written form. Old rule: 'Dates run from large to small: year 年 + month 月 + day 日/号 (+ weekday): 2020年12月25日, 七月十号. Weekdays: 星期 + 一…六; Sunday is 星期日 or 星期天. Clock time: number + 点 (o'clock) + number + 分 (minutes): 两点 (2:00, with 两), 两点二十五(分), 三点零五(分) (零 before single-digit minutes); 半 = half past (五点半); 一刻 = quarter past, 三刻 = quarter to the next hour (两点一刻 = 2:15, 两点三刻 = 2:45); 差 + minutes + hour = 'to' (差两分八点 = 7:58). Time expressions go before the verb, larger unit first (我们明天八点出发). A date, day or clock time can be the predicate without 是 (明天星期五, 现在八点二十分).'

items.title: 把 sentences (basic): doing something to a specific thing
items.rule: Subject + 把 + Object + Verb + something more. The object is a specific, known thing, and the verb cannot stand alone; it is followed by where the object ends up (在/到 + place: 老师把书放在桌子上了, 我把朋友送到车站了), who gets it (给 + person: 他们把作业交给老师了, 请把杂志递给我), a result or direction (你把书架上的书放整齐, 他把洗好的衣服拿回来了), or 了 (记得把灯关了). Negatives go before 把: 他没把衣服挂在衣柜里. Requests and instructions: 请把杂志递给我; 你把教室的门关上吧.
items.details: Official syllabus [三54] '把'字句1 表处置: (1) 主语+把+宾语+动词+在/到+处所 (老师把书放在桌子上了。我把朋友送到车站了。) (2) 主语+把+宾语1+动词(+给)+宾语2 (爸爸把新买的手机送妹妹了。他们把作业交给老师了。) (3) 主语+把+宾语+动词+结果补语/趋向补语/状态补语 (你把书架上的书放整齐。他把洗好的衣服拿回来了。孩子们把手洗得干干净净的。); [三27] (我看见你把手机放在书包里了。). 发展汉语 (初级下 第14–16课, via CSV): the verb must not stand alone — it needs a complement or other element (她把作文写完了); the verb must act on the object; negatives go before 把 (他没把衣服挂在衣柜里); 请把杂志递给我。 成功之路 (顺利篇2 第15/21课): to say that an action moves a definite thing to a new place, use 把 (你把车放在车棚里了吗？); 把 + O + V + result (请把桌子擦干净). HSK考试大纲 三级 (via CSV): 我把帽子忘在洗手间了。记得把灯关了。你把教室的门关上吧。 Level: 2025 HSK syllabus — '把'字句1 (the three patterns above) HSK 3; '把'字句2 (V一V, V了, durations, adverbial before the verb) HSK 4.

items.common_mistake: Ending with a bare verb (*她把作文写 → 她把作文写完了) and putting 不/没 after 把 (*他把衣服没挂… → 他没把衣服挂在衣柜里).

sources.evidence: 【把】❿…〈介〉a）宾语是后面动词的受事者，整个格式大多有处置的意思：把头一扭｜把衣服洗洗。〈注意〉（1）a）b）“把”的宾语都是确定的。（2）用“把”的句子，动词后面有附加成分或补语，或前面有“一”等特种状语。但在诗歌戏曲里可以不带.

items.verified_against: CC-CEDICT 2026-05-18 (word-by-word pinyin check); HSK 3.0-Yufa with Reference Books.csv, row 184 (三级 '把'字句1) — notes quoted from 发展汉语 初级下 第14–15课, 成功之路 顺利篇2 第15/21课, HSK考试大纲 三级; independent verifier (agent), 2026-11-02

verification.notes: Checker: 6/6 OK; spoken 我把 wó bǎ, 请把 qíng bǎ, 给我 géi wǒ correct. GF examples re-found (PDF p. 47); CSV rows 184 and 249 quotes re-found. Independent: 现代汉语词典 把 〈介〉 a ('the object undergoes the verb, a disposal meaning') with 注意 (1) 'the object of 把 is always definite' and (2) 'the verb has an added element or complement (except in verse)' — the two core rules of this item; HSK 3 papers use 把 in instructions and requests: '请大家把黑板上的这些词写在本子上' (H31001 阅读 62), '把菜单儿给我' (H31001 阅读), '终于把教室打扫干净了' (H31002 阅读 46); the 2025 HSK syllabus lists '把'字句1 with the same three patterns at HSK 3 (re-checked in the syllabus text).
